decisions.reason: The budget amounts in message 24 are already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the agreement-date changes require no additional budget-field update.
The revised start and end dates do not change the existing service weekdays or session time slots.

The new sites' date ranges do not establish revised session counts, per-session charges, personnel totals, or a change to the actual-session-count formula.
The seven-week Annex B value is already represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE, so no additional propagated MODIFY is needed.
